mapper.select: SELECT USER_NO as user_no, USER_ID as user_id, USER_CODE as user_code, USER_NM as username, USER_PW as password, USER_TYPE as user_type, FIRM_ID as firm_id, FIRM_NM as firm_nm, BUSINESS_TYPE as business_type, REG_DATE as reg_date, IFNULL(WITHDRAW_YN, 'N') as withdraw, IFNULL(MONEYBANK_YN, 'N') AS money_bank, IFNULL((SELECT mb_product_code FROM MONEYBANK_USER_REQUEST WHERE CU.USER_CODE = user_code AND mb_request_date IS NOT NULL ORDER BY input_date DESC LIMIT 1), '-') AS mb_product_code, IFNULL((SELECT mb_status FROM MONEYBANK_USER_REQUEST WHERE CU.USER_CODE = user_code AND mb_request_date IS NOT NULL ORDER BY input_date DESC LIMIT 1), '-') AS mb_status FROM CBCI_USER CU WHERE BINARY(USER_ID) = TRIM(#{value})

SELECT ADMIN_TYPE as admin_type, ADMIN_ID as admin_id, ADMIN_PASSWORD as password, ADMIN_FIRM_NO as admin_firm_no, ADMIN_GRADE as admin_grade, ADMIN_NAME as username FROM CBCI_ADMIN WHERE BINARY(ADMIN_ID) = TRIM(#{value})
SELECT role_uri FROM CBCI_ROLE_URI WHERE auth_role = #{value}
